description: Nginx DNS 解析过程可能触发内存破坏风险。
remediation: 升级 Nginx 到官方修复版本。

description: PostgreSQL 某些函数处理逻辑可导致安全风险。
remediation: 升级 PostgreSQL 到厂商建议的安全版本。

description: Redis Lua 沙箱场景可能被绕过。
remediation: 升级 Redis 至 6.2.6 或以上，并配置 ACL 与绑定地址。

description: OpenSSL 在 TLS 心跳处理中存在拒绝服务风险。
remediation: 升级 OpenSSL 到修复版本，并复测 TLS 服务可用性。

description: vsftpd 某些访问控制策略可能被绕过。
remediation: 升级 vsftpd 并强化匿名访问策略。

description: OpenSSH 在特定配置下可能发生权限提升。
remediation: 升级 OpenSSH 到 8.9 及以上版本，并审查 sshd 配置。

description: Apache HTTP Server 路径遍历与潜在远程代码执行漏洞。
remediation: 升级 Apache HTTP Server 至 2.4.51 及以上。

description: Tomcat 在用户认证流程中可能被绕过。
remediation: 升级 Tomcat 至官方安全版本并检查鉴权配置。

description: Samba vfs_fruit 模块存在远程代码执行风险。
MySQL 在特定条件下可被远程攻击造成服务影响。
remediation: 升级 MySQL 至 8.0.31 或更高版本，并限制远程访问来源。

description: Windows SMBv3 压缩处理存在远程代码执行风险。
remediation: 为 Windows 主机安装官方补丁，并在必要时临时禁用 SMB 压缩。

description: 远程桌面服务存在 BlueKeep 远程代码执行风险。
remediation: 为 Windows 远程桌面服务安装补丁并启用网络级别认证。

description: Debian 打包的 Redis 在 Lua 沙箱场景下可能被绕过并执行任意代码。
remediation: 升级 Redis 版本并限制高危命令，避免未授权访问。

description: Nginx 在特定代理场景下可能泄露被隐藏的响应头信息。
remediation: 升级 Nginx 至修复版本，并检查反向代理头部策略。

description: Apache HTTP Server 在特定 RewriteRule 配置下可能触发请求走私。
remediation: 升级 Apache HTTP Server 至 2.4.56 或以上，并审查重写规则。

description: OpenSSH 用户枚举问题，未做额外防护时可能泄露有效账号信息。
remediation: 升级 OpenSSH 版本，并结合 MFA、登录尝试限速和审计策略降低风险。

description: 本地启发式规则：当 8080 端口被识别为 http-proxy 但缺少产品或版本指纹时，需要手动确认是否为暴露的代理服务。
remediation: 手动确认服务类型与版本；若为代理服务，应限制访问来源、关闭未使用代理功能并补充身份认证。

description: 本地基线规则：老版本 OpenSSH 需要人工复核弱算法、口令策略和登录审计配置。
remediation: 检查是否启用弱算法和口令登录，优先升级 OpenSSH 并结合 MFA、审计与登录限速。

description: 本地基线规则：FTP 服务存在明文传输面，需复核是否仍用于生产数据通道。
remediation: 优先迁移至 SFTP/FTPS；若必须保留 FTP，需限制来源、最小权限并隔离敏感数据。

description: 本地暴露面规则：Redis 服务对扫描面开放时，需要人工确认是否启用了 ACL、认证与绑定地址。
remediation: 核查 requirepass/ACL、bind 与 protected-mode，避免未授权访问和高危命令暴露。

description: 本地基线规则：旧版 IIS 需要复核补丁、TLS 配置和默认模块暴露情况。
remediation: 核查补丁基线、TLS 配置、默认站点与不必要模块，必要时升级到受支持版本。

description: OpenSSH may expose a remote code execution risk under specific signal handling conditions.
remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH to a fixed release and review daemon hardening settings.

description: OpenSSH agent forwarding may allow local-to-remote code execution in unsafe configurations.
remediation: Upgrade OpenSSH and restrict agent forwarding to trusted administration paths only.

description: Jenkins command parser flaws may lead to arbitrary file read and secondary compromise.
remediation: Upgrade Jenkins to a patched version and restrict administrative endpoints.

description: Apache ActiveMQ OpenWire deserialization may allow unauthenticated remote code execution.
remediation: Upgrade ActiveMQ to a fixed version and isolate management interfaces from untrusted networks.

description: Atlassian Confluence may allow unauthenticated privilege escalation in affected versions.
remediation: Upgrade Confluence and place collaboration portals behind access control.

description: JetBrains TeamCity authentication bypass can expose build infrastructure to takeover.
remediation: Upgrade TeamCity immediately and rotate secrets accessible from CI pipelines.

description: PaperCut NG or MF may be exposed to remote code execution in outdated versions.
remediation: Upgrade PaperCut and restrict printer management interfaces to trusted administrators.

description: Citrix ADC appliances may allow unauthenticated remote code execution.
remediation: Apply Citrix security updates and restrict management exposure on perimeter appliances.

description: Citrix Gateway may disclose session tokens and enable account hijacking.
remediation: Upgrade to a fixed release and invalidate existing sessions after patching.

description: Zabbix frontend flaws may allow privilege abuse or credential exposure in outdated deployments.
remediation: Upgrade Zabbix and limit frontend access to trusted operators.

description: Directly exposed Microsoft SQL Server often indicates high-value remote access to business data.
remediation: Restrict 1433/TCP to approved application servers and verify strong authentication and auditing.

description: Remote PostgreSQL exposure should be reviewed for network scope, authentication, and backup roles.
remediation: Limit 5432/TCP exposure and enforce least privilege database accounts.

description: MongoDB exposure requires manual review of authentication, replica access, and internet reachability.
remediation: Enable authentication, bind only to trusted addresses, and review backup or replica endpoints.

description: Exposed Elasticsearch nodes may leak indexed data or cluster metadata if access control is weak.
remediation: Require authentication, restrict 9200/TCP, and separate management interfaces from user traffic.

description: Kibana exposure should be reviewed for anonymous access, plugin hardening, and admin account protection.
remediation: Restrict 5601/TCP to operator networks and enforce strong administrator authentication.

description: Jenkins admin interfaces are high-value targets because they often hold CI secrets and deployment keys.
remediation: Restrict web access, rotate stored credentials regularly, and isolate agents from untrusted networks.

description: Grafana exposure may reveal dashboards, credentials, or data-source metadata if authentication is weak.
remediation: Require authentication, review anonymous access settings, and restrict management UI reachability.

description: An exposed Docker API may allow full container and host takeover without additional authentication.
remediation: Disable unauthenticated TCP access, enforce TLS, and isolate daemon control to trusted administrators.

description: Kubernetes API exposure should be treated as critical because misconfiguration may disclose cluster-wide control.
remediation: Restrict API server exposure, enforce RBAC, and verify mTLS and audit logging.

description: RabbitMQ management exposure may leak queue metadata and administrative controls.
remediation: Restrict 15672/TCP to operators only and review default users and plugins.

description: ZooKeeper exposure should be reviewed because it may reveal cluster state and coordination metadata.
remediation: Limit 2181/TCP to trusted nodes and disable unauthenticated access where possible.

description: Consul exposure may reveal service discovery data and ACL-sensitive operational metadata.
remediation: Restrict UI or API access, enable ACLs, and isolate service discovery endpoints.

description: VNC remote desktop exposure is risky because sessions often lack strong transport protection.
remediation: Restrict 5900/TCP to trusted jump hosts and require VPN or additional access control.

description: Legacy WebLogic exposure should be reviewed closely because middleware tiers often host critical applications.
remediation: Limit administrative reachability, review patch level, and isolate application middleware from user networks.

description: Legacy JBoss exposure should trigger review of management consoles, deployment endpoints, and default components.
remediation: Restrict access to management paths and verify patch level and authentication controls.

description: Tomcat on common management ports should be reviewed for manager app exposure and weak admin practices.
remediation: Disable unused manager applications and restrict management UI access.
